corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list types Kaniksu Mountain as a Crowsnest with status Abandoned, not Tower Gone, and Idaho Fire Lookouts also says Abandoned. No source says the structure was removed.
firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a camp with a crow's nest, and the state list types it as Crowsnest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 6,814 feet and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 5,814 feet. The story reports both figures and does not choose.

Two pages give 1929 for the camp and crow's nest. A University of Idaho photo and an Idaho Fire Lookouts staff entry place Jim Evans at a Kaniksu Mountain lookout in 1927, with the photo date flagged approximate. The record keeps 1929 as the build date and reports the 1927 staffing separately.

sources.title: Jim Evans on lookout at Kaniksu Mountain

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone is not supported: the state list says Crowsnest Abandoned and Idaho Fire Lookouts says Abandoned, so the story says abandoned. Elevation conflicts (6,814 vs 5,814 feet). The 1927 staffing and photo predate the 1929 build date, which the story flags. Brief coordinates 48.993, -116.91826 come from the state list, but the University of Idaho photo is geotagged 48.702786, -116.920667 and firelookout.com places the site 13 miles north of Upper Priest Lake; the coordinates need checking before publication. No photo was added because no image URL was captured. No source describes what remains today.
